TC-12

TURBOCHARGER SYSTEM — Turbocharger

11. REMOVE TURBOCHARGER STAY

12. REMOVE NO.2 TURBOCHARGER STAY

13. DISCONNECT NO.1 TURBO WATER HOSE FROM WATER OUTLET HOUSING

14. DISCONNECT UNION PIPE
Remove the union bolt and gaskets.

15. REMOVE TURBOCHARGER
Remove the four nuts, turbocharger and gasket.
